title: NUERS transaction status and customer e-receipts
customer_email: Optional customer_email: one valid checkout email address, maximum 254 characters. Omit or send null when absent. Map the checkout email explicitly; NUERS does not scan arbitrary payload fields. Invalid addresses return 422 before acceptance. Never use a customer address as an API credential.
dashboard_requirement: Every ERP, POS or e-commerce sales row must show NUERS Status, failure reason, environment, NUERS reference and last attempt. Show Success only after a valid 201 or 200 duplicate acknowledgement with matching source_event_id, external_reference and environment, non-empty id/transaction_id/receipt_id, status=durably_recorded and nuers_status=success. Persist these identifiers atomically with the local outbox acknowledgement.
errors: Show Error plus error.reason and applicable errors field messages for a rejected request. Keep the original sale locally. 402 requires wallet funding; 401/403 require credential or permission correction; 409 requires reconciliation; 422 requires mapping correction. For timeouts, invalid JSON, malformed 2xx or error.outcome=unknown, show Pending confirmation and retry the identical original event. Honor Retry-After and bounded backoff for 429/5xx. Never render server messages as HTML or expose credentials to the customer.
receipt_delivery: A newly accepted Live event containing customer_email queues one customer PDF email in the same database transaction. Exact retries return the same record and do not queue another email or fee. Failed/rolled-back events queue no email. Sandbox always returns suppressed_sandbox and never emails customers. Existing transactions are not emailed retroactively.
branding: Email attachments use the same receipt renderer and E-Receipt Logo saved under Merchant Invoice Settings → Logo and Branding. This logo is independent from the Business Profile Picture; both uploads save immediately without administrator approval. Original seller identity, lines, taxes, discounts and totals remain the recorded snapshot. Save branding before the email worker renders the PDF; changes affect subsequent renders and cannot recall an already sent attachment.
delivery_status: Poll GET status_url with the same environment and transactions:read scope for customer_receipt.status and reason. States: not_requested, suppressed_sandbox, queued, preparing, sending, smtp_accepted, failed, uncertain, expired, cancelled. smtp_accepted means the SMTP server accepted the message, not confirmed inbox delivery. Email failures never change a successfully recorded sale to Error. Do not retry the sale to resend mail; use the merchant document Send Copy action after investigating an uncertain delivery.
bir_fields: Merchant transaction, batch and wallet responses do not expose bir_acceptance, bir_connection, bir_status or internal preparation blockers. Display NUERS status in the connector. NUERS Success confirms platform recording; it does not assert government acceptance.
